en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European village nestled in gently rolling hills. The scene shows clustered timber‑frame and plaster houses with steep gabled roofs, trees scattered between the buildings, and narrow unpaved streets. The image has a printed caption in the upper left corner reading "Klingenberg i. Sa." and a handwritten number "15698" in red ink in the upper right.
